info.label: Month of Eligibility
info.notes:
Denotes the year (four-digit) and month (two-digit) during which the Medi-Cal beneficiary was eligible for Medi-Cal.

* YYYY-MM (e.g., 2016-01 is January 2016)

info.label: County
info.notes:
Medi-Cal beneficiary’s county of residence.

* 58 counties

Medi-Cal beneficiary’s age arranged into one of four age groups:

* Children 0-18
* Adults 19-44
* Adults 45-64
* Seniors 65 and older.

info.label: Ethnicity
info.notes:
Identifies the Medi-Cal beneficiary’s race/ethnicity.

* AI/AN (American Indian/Alaskan Native)
* ASIAN
* BLACK
* HISPANIC
* NOT REPORTED (Other/Not Reported)
* WHITE

info.label: Total Eligibles
info.notes: The total number of individuals certified eligible for the month of eligibility. Certified eligibles are those beneficiaries deemed qualified for Medi-Cal by a valid eligibility determination, and who have enrolled into the program. This classification excludes beneficiaries who have not met a monthly share-of-cost obligation.

info.label: Annotation Code
info.notes:
Code for type annotation.

* 1= suppressed due to small number
* 2= suppressed due to complimentary cell small number
* 3= No data available

info.label: Annotation Description
info.notes: Description of Annotation for COUNT columns.

info.label: Status
info.notes:
Certified eligible counts with a status of "P" are preliminary and subject to change. A specific month's eligibility count is considered complete for statistical reporting purposes 12 months after the month's end and indicates a status of "F" for final.

* P (Preliminary)
* F (Final)
